titulo: Volver a + infinitive to say again
subtitulo: Volví a surfear: doing something again.
regla: Volver (conjugated) + a + infinitive = to do again: volví a llamarla. In the present it often refers to the future.

bloques.texto: To say an action **happens again**, use **volver** (conjugated) + **a** + **infinitive**.

Here **volver** loses its literal meaning (_to go back somewhere_). The infinitive carries the meaning: **volvió al teatro** = _she went back to the theater_; **volvió a trabajar en el teatro** = _she worked at the theater again_.
It works in every tense. In the **present**, it often refers to the **future**: **este verano vuelvo a trabajar en la tienda**.
In negative sentences it means _never again, not … again_: **no hemos vuelto a ver a Susana**.
Don't forget the **a**. Remember **volver** is o > ue: **vuelvo**, **vuelves**.
Tip: **volver a** is the replay button.

lista.es: Este verano ==vuelvo a trabajar== en esa tienda.
lista.en: This summer I'm working at that store again.

lista.es: Si ==vuelves a llamarme== creída, me voy a enojar.
lista.en: If you call me stuck-up again, I'm going to get mad.

lista.es: No ==hemos vuelto a ver== a Susana.
El carro ==volvió a derrapar== en la segunda curva.
lista.en: The car skidded again on the second curve.

lista.es: No ==voy a volver a pisar== ese bar nunca.
lista.en: I'm never setting foot in that bar again.

lista.es: Después de la lesión, ==volví a rolar==.
lista.en: After the injury, I started rolling again.

filas.t: Volví a surfear en la playa.

lista.nota: First: _I went back_. Second: _I surfed again_.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I'll call you again tomorrow._
In Spanish: _We never saw him again._
